laments.title: O Zahra, O Zahra, O Zahra
laments.about: An English translation of the lament for Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her).
laments.refrain: O Zahra, O Zahra, O Zahra

ar: كَيفَ جَاءُوا آهِ يا فِضَةُ قُولِي
en: Our hearts weep for you, O daughter of the Messenger,
As they behold the nail piercing the rib of the Pure Lady.
Alas! They cry out in anguish and disbelief,
How could they have come to this? O Fiddah, tell me!

ar: قد أتى رِجسٌ وأدمَى مِنْهَا ضِلعَا
en: Fiddah replied, striking her head in mourning and lamentation:
An impure wretch came and wounded her rib,
And they caused her unborn child to miscarry, bringing tears of grief.
And through the blood they spilled, they established a precedent.

ar: في سَماءِ الْمُصطفى قد جَاءَ يَلهَب
en: That very nail made Zaynab’s heart weep,
Beneath the heavens of the Chosen Prophet, it came burning fiercely.
Scorching hot — alas! — against a chest stained with blood,
And with a blazing whip — alas! — she was struck.

ar: كَيفَ قَد يُعلاَ لها الْيومَ أنِينا
en: She is the greatest of all the women of the worlds,
She is the innermost secret of the Commander of the Faithful.
She is the fountain of generosity for all who seek,
How could her cries of pain be raised today?

ar: كَسرٌ بابٍ في الْمَعَالي قَد تَمجَد
قَد تَمَادى في غِيابِ الْهَادِي مُرتَد
en: Within the home of the Chosen Prophet, Allah bears witness,
A door was broken — a door exalted in honour and dignity.
And there stood al-Murtadha (Imam Ali), bound in chains,
While a renegade went to extremes in the absence of the Guide.
